find_connected_components: find all connected nonzero components in a 3D or 4D numpy array using connected_components
check_convex_hull: check if a point lies inside the convex hull of a set of points using in_hull
find_nearby_objects: find all nearby interesting connected block components near a position using all_nearby_objects
find_closest_object: find the closest interesting object to a position using closest_nearby_object
label_top_bottom_blocks: label blocks as top, bottom, or neither based on vertical position using label_top_bottom_blocks
